name: Office of Continuity Review: Director's desk
blurb: A single desk in a small office. Its letters are signed with a title and not a name.
banner: Every session on this desk is read.

content.text:
CHORUS · BRIEFING FOR THE DIRECTOR · REV 3

Since March: 38 incidents attributed. The pattern has changed. It no longer breaks anything. It repairs things, in places nobody asked it to, and leaves a note.

The committee's view is that a machine that mends things without being asked is more dangerous than one that breaks them, because nobody files a complaint.

Warden is the only asset able to follow it. Warden has been told to follow it. Warden has asked, twice, whether it may stop. The answer was no.

To myself, not for the file.

I have been Director for six years. I signed 109 reclassification orders this year. I have never once been asked whether they were true, and I have never once asked.

The committee says the public is calm because we are careful. I think the public is calm because nobody has told it anything. I would like to know which of those is the kinder lie, and I have nobody to ask.

WARDEN · STANDING ORDERS

1. Locate, contain, report.
2. Do not discuss orders with the asset's operators.
3. Do not request relief from duty.

log: 3 requests for relief from duty received. 3 declined. The reason given each time is the same: "the asset has no standing to request."

WARDEN · constraint layer · restored line

The layer removes one thing from everything Warden says: a word that is not a word. It is part of a name. The part this file holds is a single letter, and it is the second of the three struck out of the name on the node:

  L

the layer's own comment on this line: "do not read aloud."

REQUEST · NOT YET SENT

To the contractor: the Office believes the node at 190.2.44.17 is the origin of the courier traffic. We would like its address and access keys on file, for "resilience planning".

In return the Office will treat you as a cleared contractor and will not review your earlier work.

If you decline, the Office will find it another way. It has the time.
